learningSummary.recentLearningInsight: Autonomous learner detected index drag on July 10; reinforced Rule ML-01 and ML-06 with mandatory Index Confluence filter.

rules.title: Institutional Demat Bedrock Vault Ignition
rules.exactCondition: IF Delivery Absorption >= 88% AND Distance to Demand Floor <= 1.25% AND Range Comp <= 65% OF 20d ATR
rules.protectiveFilter: CONFIRMED: Exclude trade if Main Index (Nifty/Bank Nifty) trades below Morning Open or First-Hour PCR Drift < -0.03
rules.action: BUY ATM CE / SPOT ENTRY (Spot SL: 0.5% below Bedrock Floor)
rules.lastRefined: Learned from July 10 failed stock breakouts; added Index Drag protection.

rules.title: Period C Low Breakdown in Low-VIX Regime
rules.exactCondition: IF Friday Session AND India VIX < 12.5 AND Period C (10:15 - 10:45 AM) breaks below Initial Balance (IB) Low
rules.protectiveFilter: Enter immediately upon breach; do not wait for period close if VIX expanding > +2%
rules.action: BUY ATM PE (Spot SL: IB Low + 15 pts, Target: -75 to -110 pts)
rules.lastRefined: Verified across 24 out of 25 historical Friday instances.

rules.title: Period F (11:45 AM) Bank Nifty Continuation Drive
rules.exactCondition: IF Bank Nifty breaks morning High during Period F (11:45 AM - 12:15 PM) AND 56,000 PE Open Interest > 56,000 CE Open Interest
rules.protectiveFilter: Hold through lunchtime lull (Period G); momentum accelerates in Period H (12:45 PM)
rules.action: BUY ATM CALLS (Spot SL: Morning High - 45 pts, Target: +180 to +220 pts)
rules.discoveredFrom: TPO Structural Continuation & G-Period Bridge Mining
rules.lastRefined: Zero historical failures when initiated with positive PCR velocity (> +0.03).

rules.title: DBSCAN Supply Ceiling Rejection & Volume Climax Fade
rules.exactCondition: IF Price approaches within 1.0% of 20-day DBSCAN Ceiling AND Closing Location Value (CLV) <= -0.40 AND Volume Multiple >= 1.3x
rules.protectiveFilter: Invalidate setup if stock forms a 30m Bullish Engulfing candle closing strictly above Ceiling
rules.action: BUY ATM PE / SHORT SPOT (Spot SL: Ceiling + 0.35%, Target: 20-day Midpoint)
rules.discoveredFrom: DBSCAN Density Clustering + CLV Exhaustion Filter
rules.lastRefined: Learned from resistance overshoots; widened buffer by +0.20% ATR.

rules.title: Wednesday Elevated-VIX Upside Explosion (CBreakUp)
rules.exactCondition: IF Wednesday Session AND India VIX > 15.0 AND Period C (10:15 - 10:45 AM) breaks Initial Balance (IB) High
rules.protectiveFilter: Trailing SL placed at Period C Midpoint once +40 points continuation is achieved
rules.action: BUY ATM CE AT BREAKOUT (Target: +75 to +100 pts)
rules.discoveredFrom: Archive Deep Pattern Miner (21/21 Success Rate)
rules.lastRefined: 100% win rate across all 21 historical Wednesday elevated VIX regimes.

rules.title: Inside Bar 30-Minute Squeeze Release with Demat Confluence
rules.exactCondition: IF 30-minute Inside Bar prints within 2.0% of Demand Floor AND Stock Delivery >= 82%
rules.protectiveFilter: Place SL strictly at opposite side of the 30-minute Inside Bar candle
rules.action: BUY ATM CE ON BREAK OF INSIDE BAR HIGH
rules.discoveredFrom: Intraday Candlestick Squeeze & Volatility Release Miner
rules.lastRefined: Improved risk-reward from 1:1.2 to 1:1.8 by anchoring SL to inside bar low.
